definitions.explanation: Physical attractiveness, especially of the face. Traditionally used more often for women's looks.
The ability or capacity to handle important tasks or leadership. Refers to someone's overall competence and character.

examples.japanese: {器量|きりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{器量|きりょう}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}して→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't judge people by their looks alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{器量|きりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a time when a woman's worth was said to be determined by her looks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{器量|きりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He has the caliber to be a leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{器量|きりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われている→問う：02299_tou⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦それなり→それなり：30238_sorenari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{器量|きりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A certain level of caliber is needed to lead a large organization.

notes:
A compound of {器|き} (vessel; capacity) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (measure; amount). The two senses are quite different: sense 1 (looks) is somewhat old-fashioned and more commonly applied to women; sense 2 (ability) applies to anyone and is still actively used in business and leadership contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {器量|きりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: good-looking (sense 1); capable (sense 2)
- {器量|きりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: plain-looking; unattractive
- {器量|きりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧: one's caliber is tested
- {器量|きりょう}⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧: a woman whose looks outshine her other qualities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧: appearance; looks — more neutral and modern term for physical appearance
- ⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧: caliber; vessel — the character standing alone; used metaphorically for a person's capacity (⟦{器|うつわ}が{大|おお}きい→器が大きい：25704_utsuwagaookii⟧ = magnanimous)
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: talent; ability — focuses on specific skills rather than overall character and leadership capacity
